claim_boundary: internal frozen holdouts; no prospective registration or population injectivity claim
legacy_seismic_status: historical exploratory pilot only; excluded from confirmatory metrics

channel_subset_protocol.recomputation: for every subset, rerun centering and global RMS canonicalization before recomputing both primitives and the frozen ratio
channel_subset_protocol.subsets: all 31 nonempty subsets of the five observed sine channels

weak_class_dependent_correlation_bootstr.resampling: sample 120 weak-coupling records with replacement; recompute dependent Spearman correlations on the same resample

selected_minus_oriented_radial_permutati.orientation: negative radial permutation entropy, chosen to align its observed association with mean |Z_2|

kuramoto.interpretation: post-hoc order-sensitive multichannel surrogate within the named Kuramoto generator

stratified_record_bootstrap.sampling: resample 120 records with replacement within each label stratum

record_bootstrap.pooled_sampling: resample 120 records with replacement within each label stratum
record_bootstrap.weak_class_sampling: resample the 120 weak-coupling records with replacement

random_perfect_matchings.interpretation: pairing-sensitivity range, not a confidence interval

prohibited_interpretations: evidence beyond the named controlled generator

sine_channel_identity.boundary: the identity precedes added Gaussian measurement noise; the released noisy array then undergoes channel centering and global RMS normalization, and the frozen ratio is not Z_1, Z_2, or a conserved quantity
sine_channel_identity.noiseless_centered_sensor: ||sin(theta)-mean_t sin(theta)||^2 = N/2*(1-Re Z_2) - 2*sum_j(mean_t sin(theta_j))*sin(theta_j) + sum_j(mean_t sin(theta_j))^2

time_reversal_noncompleteness.interpretation: time orientation is not identified by the recurrence spectrum
